text:
Maya: quick idea drop 9 — we want a tight, measurable pricing page microexperiment focused on mid-market self-serve. core pieces: FAQ rewrite (reduce friction), alternative tier names, and two microcopy variants inside the cost calculator. goal = shift 5% of demo-intent to self-serve.

Alejandro: solid. what's the primary KPI? signups from pricing or clickthrough to trial?

Maya: primary = start-trial CTA clicks on pricing. secondary = contact-sales clicks and demo lead qual.

Samir: for the calc, we'll keep math identical. only change the explanatory lines, default seat assumption, and the CTA text. two calc copy variants: neutral vs conversational. i can gate via flags.

Kate: also propose testing two micro-nudges beneath CTA: "Estimate monthly cost in <30s" (Variant A) vs "Find the right plan for fast scaling" (Variant B). each targets different intent signals.

Maya: agree. keep experiment 2x2 (tier-name variant x calc-copy variant). Kate 1  please produce the two nudge lines + a short webinar follow-up blurb for nurture.

Alejandro: tier names suggestion (control): "Starter | Developer | Production". variant: "Begin | Scale | Enterprise". keep the one-line descriptors.

Marcus: heads-up: try to preserve "Enterprise" as top in the variant so enterprise buyers still find it. also confirm no pricing bands change.

Maya: prices unchanged. Marcus 1 add tag `pricing_micro_mar` on demo leads so analytics can filter experiment leads.

Marcus: done. will not touch routing; only tagging.

Emily: legal: avoid superlatives like "industry's lowest". if calc shows savings, add this caveat: "Estimates only; excludes infrastructure and third-party fees." share the FAQ PR and tag me for sign-off.

Olivia: i uploaded a Figma with placements: https://figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/pricing-microtest-2 1 frames for mobile + desktop.

Samir: instrumentation plan: events `pricing_page_view`, `pricing_cta_click`, `pricing_calc_open`, `pricing_calc_submit`, `pricing_calc_feedback`. flags: `tierNamesVariant` (A/B), `calcCopyVariant` (A/B). will add a tiny post-calc survey (one Q yes/no).

Maya: timeline: design + legal signoff by Thu, dev + flags by Fri, start 50% rollout next Mon for 14 days. reporting: Alejandro will own a temp dashboard comparing experiment vs baseline.

Alejandro: on dashboard: show trial CTR, contact-sales CTR, demo MQL rate, and percent of calc users who chose self-serve. need Amplitude events with flag context.

Kate: drafting CTA lines and webinar blurb now. will drop drafts here by EOD.

Emily: reviewed the draft FAQ this morning. small wording tweak: replace "you'll save" with "estimated savings". tagged comments in PR.

Olivia: updated Figma with Emily's change + added the small-screen accordion state.

Samir: dev QA checklist posted:

- flags toggle correctly
- experiment events include flag metadata
- calculator results unchanged
- survey modal fires after submit
- accessibility checks on accordions and CTA focus states

Maya: action list: Kate (CTA + webinar blurb) EOD; Alejandro (dashboard) Mon AM; Samir (flags + events + QA) Fri; Emily (legal signoff) Thu; Marcus (AE heads-up + lead tag) Fri; Olivia (final Figma) Thu. i'll schedule a 15-min dry run on Fri.

Alejandro: one extra ask 1 can we capture where users came from (utm) when they submit calc so we can see channel differences?

Samir: yes, adding utm capture to `pricing_calc_submit`.

Maya: great. i'll write a short note to sales before rollout. thanks everyone 680
